issue.title: just check fails at lint (pyscripts): tools/sase_bead references violate closer-dir rule
issue.description: just check failed in this workspace at lint (pyscripts). The command reached tools/pyscripts-260801 and emitted Rule 2 closer-dir errors because tools/sase_bead is referenced from six tests under tests/ace/tui even though tests/ace/tui/tools/ exists: tests/ace/tui/actions/test_prompt_config_hub_open.py, tests/ace/tui/actions/test_prompt_memory_panel_open.py, tests/ace/tui/modals/test_memory_panel_adapter.py, tests/ace/tui/test_memory_panel_catalog.py, tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_agent_display_header_summary_lanes.py, and tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_memory_panel_entry.py. My notification-backlog change did not touch those files or tools/sase_bead; focused notification tests passed.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: This is a deterministic static lint failure, not a runtime/flaky test: just check stopped before pytest at lint (pyscripts), and the reported Rule 2 path relationships are fixed by the repository tree rather than timing.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction in workspace sase_25 while implementing quiet completed machine onboarding: main repo just check rebuilt linked sase_core_rs 0.34.50, passed fmt/keep-sorted/ruff/mypy/feature flags, then failed deterministically at lint (pyscripts) with Rule 2 closer-dir errors for tools/sase_bead references from the same six tests under tests/ace/tui. My diff touches machine-init planning/docs/tests and linked core review policy, not tests/ace/tui or tools/sase_bead.

Independent reproduction during clan_single_member_status_label implementation verification on 2026-09-18 in workspace sase_26: just check passed fmt, keep-sorted, ruff, mypy, and feature flags, then failed deterministically at lint (pyscripts). tools/pyscripts-260801 reported Rule 2 closer-dir errors for tools/fix_tui_screenshots from tests/ace/tui/visual/_visual_capture.py, _visual_maintenance_cli.py, and test_fix_tui_screenshots.py, plus tools/run_pytest from tests/ace/tui/visual/_visual_maintenance.py, _visual_maintenance_run.py, and _visual_maintenance_types.py, because tests/ace/tui/tools/ exists. My diff touches clan status projection, focused clan/runner-slot tests, and docs/ace.md; it does not touch tests/ace/tui/visual or top-level tools references. This is deterministic static lint, not a flake.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP from sase-zr.7.1.1.5.4.1 note #2, independently reproduced 2026-09-19 in workspace sase_11 while landing sase-zr.7.1.1.5.4: just _lint-pyscripts failed at tools/pyscripts-260801 Rule 2 closer-dir because tests/ace/tui/tools/ exists. This epic did not touch those files. Deterministic static lint, not a flake.

Independent reproduction 2026-09-19 in workspace sase_17 while implementing plan:202609/check_full_explicit_only.md: just check passed fmt, keep-sorted, ruff, mypy, and feature flags, then failed at lint (pyscripts). tools/pyscripts-260801 Rule 2 closer-dir: tools/fix_tui_screenshots from tests/ace/tui/visual/_visual_capture.py, _visual_maintenance_cli.py, test_fix_tui_screenshots.py; tools/run_pytest from _visual_maintenance.py, _visual_maintenance_run.py, _visual_maintenance_types.py; tools/render_visual_snapshot_failure_report from _visual_maintenance_run.py, because tests/ace/tui/tools/ exists. payload.entry: NO LONGER REPRODUCES at master 624a29ea7 (2026-09-20, checked by the sase-12z.5 land agent on athena, workspace sase_29). 'just _lint-pyscripts' runs tools/pyscripts-260801 to completion and prints 'All scripts/ and tools/ directories are valid!', and 'sase tool run check' shows a green 'lint (pyscripts)' stage. The Rule 2 closer-dir errors depended on tests/ace/tui/tools/ existing; that directory no longer exists in the tree, so tools/sase_bead references from tests under tests/ace/tui are no longer closer-dir violations. This also resolves the DISCOVERED ISSUE note on epic sase-12z, which reported the same rule firing for tools/fix_tui_screenshots, tools/run_pytest and tools/render_visual_snapshot_failure_report. Left open rather than closed because I did not identify the commit that removed the directory and there is no regression guard preventing it from coming back; triage may want one.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction on master 7c763a2e7 during fix_ten_master_check_failures verification: sase tool run check stopped at lint (pyscripts) with 8 Rule 2 closer-dir errors for tools/fix_tui_screenshots, tools/run_pytest, and tools/render_visual_snapshot_failure_report referenced from tests/ace/tui/visual/*. This time the closer dir was NOT tracked: git ls-files tests/ace/tui/tools/ is empty and the directory held only an ignored __pycache__/ (likely materialized by local pytest runs). Removing that cache makes tools/pyscripts-260801 print All scripts/ and tools/ directories are valid. Impact: gate failure blocks check before the test lane on trees whose test runs created that cache; consider making Rule 2 ignore untracked/ignored directories.
